strategies.name: Momentum (12-1)
strategies.definition: Each month, hold the 10 names with the strongest trailing ~12-month return (most recent month skipped), equal-weight. Classic price-momentum; point-in-time.
strategies.methodology: Universe: 426 names with >=1y price history. Monthly rebalance to equal-weight top 10, 0.1%/trade, simulated with vectorbt. SURVIVORSHIP-BIASED (today's names) — educational illustration, not a trading system, not financial advice.

strategies.name: Fundamental (price vs value, point-in-time)
strategies.definition: Each month, hold the 10 names at the largest discount of price to their POINT-IN-TIME fundamental value (value lagged ~45d; projected points excluded), equal-weight.
strategies.methodology: Universe: 426 names with >=1y price history. Monthly rebalance to equal-weight top 10, 0.1%/trade, simulated with vectorbt. SURVIVORSHIP-BIASED (today's names) — educational illustration, not a trading system, not financial advice.
